content.title: Missouri-based Schnucks buys Wisconsin’s Festival Foods, including new Hudson store
content.summary: St. Louis-based grocery company Schnucks has purchased the Wisconsin chain Skogen’s Festival Foods, which has 42 locations around the state including a new one in Hudson. Skogen’s Festival Foods stores are unrelated to the Festival Foods-branded grocery stores around the Twin Cities.
